live: {channel} is live now — come say hi!
liveYoutube: Live on YouTube — come say hi!
ytNote: Nothing is loaded from YouTube before you click. Once started, the player connects to YouTube (Google).
needSource: No live source is installed: no banner, no player.
suggestTwitch: knows when you are live on Twitch (My Twitch channel)
suggestYoutube: knows when you are live on YouTube (YouTube channel)
ytNeedChannel: No YouTube channel is set: your YouTube lives are not announced.
ytNeedKey: The site is not connected to YouTube: your YouTube lives are not announced.
ytQuota: YouTube's daily limit of checks is reached: your YouTube lives are not announced until tomorrow.
ytDown: YouTube is not answering: your YouTube lives are not announced.
twitchApp: The site is not connected to Twitch: the player is not shown.
twitchChannel: No Twitch channel is set: the player is not shown.
sumYoutube: Lives read from the YouTube channel
